CLOUDSDALE · PONSONA HOMEPAGE
Pegasus Bluie
A blue pegasus living in Shanghai · jushen Intelligence
×
Outside research, I am also a Brony. My ponysona is a blue pegasus born in Cloudsdale who is currently studying in the human world.
My full name is Skyblue Mornbreeze. On international social media you can call me Skyblue; Bronies can call me Tianlan, while Furries like to call me Little Blue.
I am also active in communities including tulpa and pony hypnosis.
I am a devoted fan of Background Pony (although I have not finished it yet) and 4everfreebrony. You can find the music I often listen to on NetEase Cloud Music and Gallery!
I love traveling around the world with my Lyra Heartstrings plush and taking photos. I have taken more than 2,000 so far; contact me on QQ if you would like to see them.
I am improving my drawing skills and experimenting with Fimtale stories and pony electronic music. I really wish I had a sewing machine so I could make pony plushies!
My dream is to return to Cloudsdale, and that is what drives my studies and research. Perhaps one day I can build a robot pony as capable as Sweetiebot, create an intelligent and comfortable quadruped pony fursuit, or even help develop Celestia AI... I cannot wait!
